platforms.name: The Head Start
platforms.idea: Every morning, Heritage shows one small thing a family did before anyone else was awake — the poured glass that started it — and names the head start it bought them by breakfast.
platforms.rtb: purer milk carries more of what a growing family runs on, so the strength is really in the pour

expressions.video: A boy sits the state exam calm while the row around him fidgets — cut back through his morning to find the one thing he did before anyone woke: revised the two chapters he'd flagged, glass drained beside the book. What turns: the calm everyone reads as talent was bought at 5:40am, and the pour is where the head start started.
expressions.social: A daily 'Ahead by breakfast' unit: one square, one real person, one small thing they finished before the house stirred (the 6k run, the packed tiffins, the fixed cycle chain), captioned with the exact time it was done and the 'ahead' it bought them. Format fixed — task, time, the ahead — person and task rotate forever, one post every morning off the same idea.
expressions.posm: A shelf strip reading 'Ahead by breakfast' with a small clock at 5:45, the FSSAI mark and 'Pure Doodh Ki Shakti' — one time-stamp a shopper reads at two metres that turns milk from a purchase into the thing that starts the day early, against nine packs saying only 'pure'.
expressions.activation: At a society gate in the morning purchase window, a chalk-board 'What did you finish before 7?' — each early riser writes their one thing and takes a numbered dawn-glass, physically claiming their head start and reading twenty others already on the board.
expressions.incentive: Retailers get a morning-window talk-track and a small counter clock: 'the families who buy this are the ones already ahead' — a line that lets a general-trade shopkeeper sell the branded pack to the school-going, exam-season household as the parent's small edge, not a price line but a why-this-one line at the exact hour they buy.
expressions.ooh: A junction hoarding near a school gate at drop-off: one giant time-stamp — '5:45am' — and under it 'the pour that got her ahead by breakfast', so a parent stopped at the light reads their own morning back to the glass in three seconds. #PureDoodhKiShakti, FSSAI mark, no scene to decode — just the hour and the ahead it bought.
expressions.pr: The checkable fact is the RTB itself, sourced from the brand's own composition data: per-glass, purer milk delivered to the door carries measurably more of a named nutrient a growing child runs on than the category baseline — a number a journalist can verify against the pack, not a sentiment. [unverified — brand must supply the tested figure]
expressions.media: A dawn-weighted always-on drip, not a burst: the platform lives at 5:30–7:30am, so social posts land at actual dawn and in-store weight sits in the morning purchase window, with the film as the anchor and the daily unit carrying the spend across the year.

campaigns.insight: She sees her child finish the ordinary things every day, but never lets herself believe those small daily wins are proof of the strength she's building — she's waiting for a big moment that never announces itself.
